description: Godot 4.3 HTML5 framework layer — main scene (Node2D + Sprite2D + Label) with a typed GDScript driving _ready diagnostics and a _process animation loop. Composes with the godot-web family to form a complete web-export scaffold.

buildHints.whenToUse: Any project using the godot-web family. This layer supplies the scene and script that project.godot points at as the main scene — without it the project opens to an empty editor with no runnable scene.
firstSteps: After composing, open the project: `godot --editor .` from the project root. The editor resolves scenes/main.tscn and scripts/main.gd automatically.
Press F5 (or the Play button) to run in the editor — the sprite spins and the label shows the Godot version string.
Validate the file structure without Godot: `node validate-godot-web.mjs` — should print `godot-web starter ok`.
Export for the web: Project → Export → select Web → Export Project. Output lands in exports/web/ as index.html + index.js + index.wasm + index.pck.
Serve exports/web/ with any static host. Browsers require COOP/COEP headers (see gotchas) — use `npx serve exports/web` for local preview.
gotchas: Godot 4 HTML5 builds require SharedArrayBuffer. Browsers only expose it when the page is served with `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin` AND `Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp`. Without these headers the canvas stays blank — configure your static host to emit them for the exports/web/ directory.

The @onready annotations in main.gd resolve at scene-tree entry. If you reparent or free Sprite2D or Label before _ready fires, the @onready vars will be null and _process will crash. Always modify the scene tree after super._ready() when overriding in subclasses.

The uid on the [gd_scene] header (`uid://c5starter0foundry`) is a stable placeholder. Godot will replace it with a generated UID the first time you save the scene in the editor — that change is safe to commit.
Do not commit the .godot/ directory — it is editor-generated cache. The family-supplied .gitignore already excludes it.
architectureNotes: This layer provides exactly one scene (scenes/main.tscn) and one script (scripts/main.gd). For real projects, add scenes as sibling files and instance them into main.tscn; don't grow main.tscn into a monolith.
main.gd uses static typing (@onready var _sprite: Sprite2D). Keep types explicit — GDScript's static analyser catches type errors at editor load rather than at runtime.
The _process loop mutates sprite transform only. Keep heavy work (file I/O, network, heavy math) out of _process; use async signals or threads instead.

placeholders.description: Bootstrap scene with Node2D root, centred Sprite2D using the default icon, and a Label. Replace with your real game scene; keep the top-level Node2D if scripts/main.gd remains attached to the root.

GDScript attached to the Node2D root — _ready logs engine version and rendering device, _process rotates the sprite. Replace _process body with real input handling and game-loop logic; preserve _ready for diagnostics.
